scripts.test:scripts: node --test scripts/push-keys.test.mjs scripts/api-schemas.test.mjs scripts/prod-bootstrap.test.mjs scripts/preview-invites.test.mjs "scripts/ci/*.test.mjs" "scripts/backup/*.test.mjs" "scripts/release/*.test.mjs" e2e/serve.test.mjs
